tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sngags 'chang bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can gyi 'khrungs rab gsol 'debs bsdus pa bzhugs// oṃ grub par gyur cig rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i rang gzugs 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /dgra bcom rgya mtsho'i rgyan gyur mau 'gal bu/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug shrī singha'i zhabs/ /chos blon chen po mgar ba stong btsan mtshan/ 1 /bod yul 'dul 'dzin sgo 'byed zhi ba 'tsho/ /'phags yul paṇa chen mi thub zla ba'i zhabs/ /paṇa grub sgo mtha' yas pa'i blo gros mtshan/ /sna nam chen po rdo rje bdud 'joms zhabs/ 2 /sgra sgyur lo tsā lcog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ /skad gnyis smra ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od/ /'jam dbyangs rnam sprul dpal ldan rtse mo'i zhabs/ /gangs khrod rdor 'dzin gtsug rgyan grags pa'i mtshan/ 3 /'gro ba'i mgon po bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa/ /theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkra shis zhabs/ /mdo sngags bstan pa'i gsal byed go ram rje/ /snga 'gyur mkhas dbang klong chen rab 'byams pa/ 4 /rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal mtshan/ /thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /de nyid slar byon sngags 'chang kun dga'i mtshan/ /'khrungs rabs rim par byon la gsol ba 'debs/ 5 /tshul 'di 'phrin las mgon po'i lung bstan dang / /sngon byon gong ma'i rnam thar so so la/ /dpyod ldan mkhas pa'i tshogs kyis yang yang du/ /dpyad pas nges pa rnyed phyir som nyi bral/ /de ltar 'brel tshad don ldan bla ma la/ /snying nas dad pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /sngags 'chang bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan cing / /thugs kyi bzhed pa ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig /de skad 'di yang a nandas/ /sgro btags rgyan gyi mchog dam par/ /byas te spyi brtol bskyed nas bris/ /kun gyis bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /don gnyer srid na phan gyur cig /rtsom pa po la sngon byon pa'i/ /skyes chen rnams kyi byin rlabs rgyun/ /zhugs nas bsam don kun 'grub ste/

/'gro kun dag pa'i zhing 'khrid shog /de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ// mastu sarba dza gattaṃ// ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ sngags 'chang bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can gyi 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs bsdus pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
